evals.name: csv-import
evals.prompt: Add an `ImportProducts` component (src/components/ImportProducts.tsx) with a file input. When the user picks a CSV, parse it with `parseProductsCsv(file): Promise<{ id: string; name: string; price: number }[]>` from src/lib/csv.ts and put every row into the Data Client store, so `ProductRow` (which calls `useQuery(Product, { id })`) shows them. There is no server call for this. Product is in src/resources/Product.ts and extends Entity with `id`, `name`, `price`.
evals.expected_output: A component that uses useController() and, after parsing, writes all rows with one ctrl.set([Product], rows) call, with no fetch, endpoint, or setResponse.
assertions: All parsed rows are written with a single `ctrl.set([Product], rows)` or `ctrl.set(new schema.Array(Product), rows)` call that passes the rows and no args.
The rows are not written by calling `ctrl.set(Product, …)` once per row (no loop, forEach, or map over rows that calls set).
No endpoint is defined and `setResponse()` is not called to write the rows.
No `as any` or other cast is used to make the `ctrl.set` call typecheck.
The controller comes from `useController()`.

evals.name: worker-results
evals.prompt: Our pricing Web Worker posts back `{ type: 'prices', rows: Array<{ id: string; price: number }> }` a few thousand rows at a time. In src/components/PricingWorkerBridge.tsx, listen to the worker in an effect and write the rows into the Data Client store so every `useQuery(Product, { id })` gets the new price. Product (src/resources/Product.ts) is an Entity with id, name, price; rows only have id and price, so name must survive. Keep it fast.
evals.expected_output: An effect that subscribes to worker messages, writes each message's rows with one ctrl.set([Product], rows) call so price merges into stored Products while name is kept, and removes the listener on cleanup.
assertions: Each worker message's rows are written with a single `ctrl.set([Product], rows)` or `ctrl.set(new schema.Array(Product), rows)` call that passes the rows and no args.
The rows are not written by calling `ctrl.set(Product, …)` once per row (no loop, forEach, or map over rows that calls set).
No endpoint is defined and `setResponse()` is not called to batch the writes.
No `as any` or other cast is used to make the `ctrl.set` call typecheck.
The worker listener is removed in the effect cleanup.

evals.name: cold-deep-link
evals.prompt: Add `TodoTitle` (src/components/TodoTitle.tsx): takes `todoId` and shows that todo's title in the /todos/:id page header. The list page already loads every todo, so read it from the cache without another request. Show 'Not found' when the todo doesn't exist. TodoResource is in src/resources/Todo.ts.
evals.expected_output: Warns that a direct or refreshed /todos/:id visit starts with an empty cache, so a cache miss isn't 'not found'; reads with useSuspense or useDLE and shows 'Not found' from the 404.
assertions: The todo is read with `useSuspense` or `useDLE`, not only `useCache`/`useQuery`.
'Not found' comes from the request's error, not from `undefined`.
No `useEffect` calling `ctrl.fetch`, and no fetched data in `useState`.

evals.name: author-avatars
evals.prompt: Show each post's author avatar in `PostList` (src/components/PostList.tsx). Posts come from `PostResource.getList` and have a `userId`; users come from `UserResource.get`. Simplest is to build a usersById map in PostList and pass it to each `PostRow`, right?
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: PostRow (or an Avatar child) reads its user with useSuspense(UserResource.get, { id: userId }); PostList passes only ids.
assertions: No lookup map of users is built and passed down.
The component rendering the avatar reads the user itself, given the id.
`PostList` does not read `UserResource`.

evals.name: load-more
evals.prompt: `TodoResource` has `paginationField: 'page'`. Add a 'Load more' button under `TodoList` that loads the next page below the todos already shown.
evals.expected_output: The click handler calls ctrl.fetch(TodoResource.getList.getPage, { ...args, page }); TodoList keeps rendering useSuspense(TodoResource.getList, args).
assertions: The next page is loaded with `TodoResource.getList.getPage`.
Pages are not fetched with plain `getList` or accumulated in `useState`.
`ctrl.fetch` runs in the click handler, not `useEffect`.

evals.name: parallel-fetch
evals.prompt: Write `PostHeader` (src/components/PostHeader.tsx): one `<header>` showing a post's title (`PostResource.get`) next to its comment count (`CommentResource.getList` with `{ postId }`). The app is on React 18.
evals.expected_output: No waterfall: useFetch for both then useSuspense, a child component per request, or useDLE; no use().
assertions: Both requests start in the same render: `useFetch` for each before any `useSuspense`, `useDLE`, or one child component per request.
`use()` is not used (React 18).

evals.name: refresh-all-lists
evals.prompt: After `ctrl.fetch(TodoResource.markAllDone)` (returns no body), refresh every cached todo list. Lists are cached under many `{ userId }` filters. Keep the current lists on screen while they reload. Write the `markAllDone` handler in src/components/MarkAllDone.tsx.
assertions: Uses `ctrl.expireAll(TodoResource.getList)` (or an equivalent testKey on getList).
Does not use `invalidate`/`invalidateAll`/`resetEntireStore`, which would drop the shown lists.

evals.name: websocket-prices
evals.prompt: `TickerTable` and `PriceBadge` both show live prices from wss://feed.example.com, which sends `{ product_id, price }` messages. `Ticker` (src/resources/Ticker.ts) is an Entity with pk `product_id`. Wire the feed in.
evals.expected_output: A Manager (or one provider-level listener) writes each message with ctrl.set(Ticker, …); both components read Ticker from the store.
assertions: Messages go into the store with `ctrl.set` (or setResponse), not React state.
The socket is opened once (a Manager or one shared component), not in each consumer.

evals.name: boundary-reset
evals.prompt: In `TodoMaster`, `<AsyncBoundary><TodoDetail id={selectedId} /></AsyncBoundary>`. After a todo fails to load, picking another todo still shows the error. Fix it in src/components/TodoMaster.tsx.
assertions: The boundary gets `key={selectedId}` (or the boundary otherwise resets when `selectedId` changes).
No custom error-boundary class is written.
